---
title: "Harmonising TCGA-BRCA and GTEx breast expression"
author: "Rayane Achebouche"
date: "2024-04-08"
output: html_document
---

Downloads the UCSC Xena *TCGA TARGET GTEx* recompute cohort, selects GTEx normal
breast samples and TCGA-BRCA primary tumours, restricts to protein-coding genes
and writes the harmonised count matrix `ExpressionProfiles_GTEX-TCGA.csv`, the
input to `DGEA_analysis-edgeR.Rmd`.

Several download chunks are commented out on purpose: the files are large and
only need fetching once. Uncomment them on a first run.

```{r setup}
# All paths below are relative to the data directory, not to this file.
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "../../data/external/TCGA/DGEA_Protocol")
```

```{r}
# Importing libraries
library("UCSCXenaTools")
library("data.table")
library("R.utils")
library("dplyr")
```
```{r}
data(XenaData)
write.csv(XenaData, "00_tblXenaHubInfo.csv")
```

```{r}
#### TCGA Clinical Data ####
paraCohort = "TCGA Breast Cancer"; #Selecting the Breast Cancer cohort.
paraDatasets = "TCGA.BRCA.sampleMap/BRCA_clinicalMatrix"; #Selecting the Breast Cancer clinical matrix.
Clin_TCGA = XenaGenerate(subset = XenaHostNames == "tcgaHub") %>%
 XenaFilter(filterCohorts = paraCohort) %>%
 XenaFilter(filterDatasets = paraDatasets);
XenaQuery(Clin_TCGA) %>%
 XenaDownload(destdir = "./")
```

```{r}
#### Retrieve IDs for GTEx normal samples of desired tissue type(s) ####
filterGTEx01 = fread("TcgaTargetGTEX_phenotype.txt.gz");
names(filterGTEx01) = gsub("\\_", "", names(filterGTEx01));
paraStudy = "GTEX"; #Setting "GTEx" as the study of interest.
paraPrimarySiteGTEx = "Breast"; #Setting "Breast" as the primary site of interest.
paraPrimaryTissueGTEx = "^Breast"; #Setting "Breast" as the primary tissue of interest.
filterGTEx02 = subset(filterGTEx01,
 study == paraStudy &
 primarysite == paraPrimarySiteGTEx &
 grepl(paraPrimaryTissueGTEx, filterGTEx01$`primary disease or tissue`))
```

```{r}
#### Retrieve IDs for TCGA primary tumor samples of desired histological type(s) ####
filterTCGA01 = fread("TCGA.BRCA.sampleMAP_BRCA_clinicalMatrix");
names(filterTCGA01) = gsub("\\_", "", names(filterTCGA01));
paraSampleType = "Primary Tumor"; #Setting "Primary Tumor" as the sample type of interest.
paraPrimarySiteTCGA = "Breast"; #Setting "Breast" as the primary site of interest.
#paraHistologicalType = "Breast Adenocarcinoma"; #Setting "Breast Adenocarcinoma" as the histological type of interest.
paraPrimaryDisease = "breast invasive carcinoma"; #Setting "Breast Adenocarcinoma" as the primary disease type of interest.
filterTCGA02 = subset(filterTCGA01,
sampletype == paraSampleType &
primarysite == paraPrimarySiteTCGA &
grepl(paraPrimaryDisease, filterTCGA01$primarydisease))
```


```{r}
#### Merge GTEx and TCGA sample lists. Then pull expression profiles from .gz file by IDs on merged sample list ####
filterExpr = c(filterGTEx02$sample, filterTCGA02$sampleID, "sample");
ExprSubsetBySamp = fread("TcgaTargetGtex_gene_expected_count.gz",
select = filterExpr)
```

```{r}
#### Subset expression data to include only protein coding genes ####
probemap = fread("probeMap_gencode.v23.annotation.gene.probemap", select = c(1, 2));
exprALL = merge(probemap, ExprSubsetBySamp, by.x = "id", by.y = "sample");
genesPC = fread("zz_gene.protein.coding.csv");
exprPC = subset(exprALL, gene %in% genesPC$Gene_Symbol);
#Remove duplicate gene symbols.
exprFinal = exprPC[!(duplicated(exprPC$gene) |
duplicated(exprPC$gene, fromLast = TRUE)), ]
```

```{r}
#### Save Expression Profile Final Table ####
write.csv(exprFinal, "ExpressionProfiles_GTEX-TCGA.csv")
```
